result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: a '-0%' badge on the pizza restaurant card that appears to be a data bug.

issues.description: Discount badge on the second card under 'Popular right now' (pizza image) displays '-0%', which is nonsensical and looks like a data or logic bug.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when discount is 0 or fix backend logic to show a valid discount value (e.g., '-20%') or other meaningful promotion label.
